findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to another tenant. Any caller relying on this exported authorization helper now loses the tenant boundary previously enforced by comparing both tenant identifiers.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 8be77c02b93c8beae91b386098f6cd46692896b5, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full base-to-head diff shows the tenant equality check was removed. The unrelated src/labels.ts label change does not restore authorization, so cross-tenant reads remain allowed.
